svg.title: Pass/fail heatmap of all 26 scored cases across three repetitions
svg.desc: Grid of 26 rows by 3 repetition columns, grouped into 16 stable-pass, 5 flaky, and 5 stable-fail cases; each cell is green for pass or coral for fail, showing that both adversarial cases and two high-tool-count cases from phase 5 are the flaky ones, while the fabrication cluster and one Groundedness case fail in every repetition.
svg.text: F — at least one metric failed
